in_sanskrit.name: रानक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings joy in the night, the night joy.

in_hindi.name: रानक
in_hindi.meaning: रात्रि के साथ अनेक सुख, खुशियों से पूरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bringer of joy in the night, filled with numerous joys and happiness.

in_tamil.name: ரானக்
in_tamil.meaning: ஆட்டம் அல்லது அழகுத்து, காலையில் அனைத்து அல்லது ஆவையில் அனைத்து குஷ்பம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who brings happiness in the night or in the early morning, the one who brings joy everywhere.

in_telugu.name: రానక్
in_telugu.meaning: శయేదిని చేయిపోయే, రజుగేపోయే చేయిపోయే, చిన్నదేశీయే, దేశీయే
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who brings happiness to the one who is lonely, the one who brings joy to the one who is sad, the one who is the god of desire, the one who is the god of wealth.

in_marathi.name: Raunak
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joy, happiness, delight
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raunak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who delights, one who brings joy and happiness, one who is pleased with himself

in_bengali.name: Raunak
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Joy, happiness, delight
in_bengali.long_meaning: Raunak একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who delights, one who brings joy and happiness, one who is pleased with himself
